# SetMinWindowSize <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Windows](BlitzPlus-Windows)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetMinWindowSize:Void window:Int32, width:Int32=-1, height:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a window that can be resized. |
| `width` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Smallest width. Defaults to -1, which takes the current width. |
| `height` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Smallest height. Defaults to -1, which takes the current height. |

## Description

Sets how small the user may make a window. Without the sizes, the current size of the window becomes the smallest one. The biggest size is always the size of the desktop.

## Differences

* The help lists height before width in its syntax line, the real order is width then height.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Not too small", 20, 20, 240, 160, Desktop(), 15)
SetMinWindowSize win, 160, 100
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
